title: Episode
description: An episode arc. References scenes in order, with optional hooks and DM-only beats.

prerequisites.description: Other episodes that must have played before this one. By id or name.

hooks.description: Ways PCs typically end up in this episode.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scene file names (relative paths under scenes/) that this episode reveals during play. Public scenes only — DM-only beats live elsewhere.

arcBeats.description: Which main-arc beats this episode touches. DM-only. References by id.

inGameDate.description: In-game date or rough timeframe. Used by the AI prompt-bar to reason about which world events are anchored at play time.
